metadata.name: Russian + Ukrainian Usenet
metadata.description:
Usenet-only filtering and sorting profile driven by the Stream Expression Language (SEL).

- Keeps only Usenet releases with **Russian or Ukrainian** audio.
- Prefers **HDR** over SDR.
- Limits resolution to **2160p / 1080p / 720p** — 720p is only shown when fewer than 5 x 1080p results exist.
- Subtitles are not required or filtered.

Priority order (highest first):
1. Russian/Ukrainian + HDR
2. Russian/Ukrainian + SDR

See the [README](https://github.com/JCSynthTux/AIOStreams-SEL-Templates) for full documentation.
metadata.author: JCSynthTux

excludedStreamExpressions.expression: /* Audio: Russian or Ukrainian */ negate(merge(language(streams, 'Russian'), language(streams, 'Ukrainian')), streams)
/* 720p only when fewer than 5 x 1080p */ count(resolution(streams, '1080p')) >= 5 ? resolution(streams, '720p') : []

preferredStreamExpressions.expression: /* Russian/Ukrainian + SDR */ negate(visualTag(merge(language(streams, 'Russian'), language(streams, 'Ukrainian')), 'HDR', 'DV', 'HDR10', 'HDR10+', 'HLG'), merge(language(streams, 'Russian'), language(streams, 'Ukrainian')))
